questions.question: A woman travels 432 km at 72 km/hr, a second distance of 275 km at 55 km/hr and a third distance of 680 km at 85 km/hr. Find her average speed for the whole journey (in km/hr).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First distance = 432 km, speed = 72 km/hr

Second distance = 275 km, speed = 55 km/hr

Third distance = 680 km, speed = 85 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time for first distance = 432 ÷ 72 = 6 hours

⇒ Time for second distance = 275 ÷ 55 = 5 hours

⇒ Time for third distance = 680 ÷ 85 = 8 hours

⇒ Total distance = 432 + 275 + 680

⇒ Total distance = 1387 km

⇒ Total time = 6 + 5 + 8

⇒ Total time = 19 hours

⇒ Average speed = 1387 ÷ 19

⇒ Average speed = 73 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 73 km/hr.**

questions.question: The income of Raman is ₹34,000. He saves 28% of his income. If his income increases by 11% and expenditure increases by 30%, then his savings will:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Income of Raman = ₹34,000

Savings percentage = 28%

Income increase percentage = 11%

Expenditure increase percentage = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Income × Savings percentage

Expenditure = Income - Savings

New Income = Income × (1 + Income increase percentage / 100)

New Expenditure = Expenditure × (1 + Expenditure increase percentage / 100)

New Savings = New Income - New Expenditure

Change in Savings = New Savings - Old Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Old Savings = ₹34,000 × 28 / 100 = ₹9,520

⇒ Old Expenditure = ₹34,000 - ₹9,520 = ₹24,480

⇒ New Income = ₹34,000 × (1 + 11 / 100) = ₹34,000 × 1.11 = ₹37,740

⇒ New Expenditure = ₹24,480 × (1 + 30 / 100) = ₹24,480 × 1.30 = ₹31,824

⇒ New Savings = ₹37,740 - ₹31,824 = ₹5,916

⇒ Change in Savings = ₹5,916 - ₹9,520 = -₹3,604

**∴ The correct answer is decrease by ₹3,604.**

questions.question: An amount of ₹432 is divided among three persons in the ratio of 5 : 14 : 17. The difference between the largest and the smallest shares (in ₹) in the distribution is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total amount = ₹432

Ratio of shares = 5 : 14 : 17

**Formula Used:**

Sum of ratio terms = Ratio₁ + Ratio₂ + Ratio₃

Individual share = (Ratio of person × Total amount) / Sum of ratio terms

Difference between largest and smallest share = Largest share - Smallest share

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of ratio terms = 5 + 14 + 17 = 36

⇒ Smallest share = (5 × 432) / 36 = 60

⇒ Largest share = (17 × 432) / 36 = 204

⇒ Difference = 204 - 60 = 144

**∴ The correct answer is 144.**

questions.question: Pipe P can fill (5)/(9) part of a tank in 25 hours, and pipe Q can fill (3)/(7) part of the same tank in 27 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 3 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 4 hours. Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe P fills 5/9 part of tank in 25 hours

⇒ Time taken by P to fill full tank = 25 × (9 ÷ 5) = 45 hours

Pipe Q fills 3/7 part of tank in 27 hours

⇒ Time taken by Q to fill full tank = 27 × (7 ÷ 3) = 63 hours

P and Q are opened for 3 hours

Pipe R empties the tank in 4 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM of 45 and 63 = 315 units

⇒ Total capacity of tank = 315 units

⇒ Efficiency of P = 315 ÷ 45 = 7 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 315 ÷ 63 = 5 units/hr

⇒ Work done by P and Q together in 1 hour = 7 + 5 = 12 units

⇒ Work done by P and Q in 3 hours = 12 × 3 = 36 units

⇒ Pipe R empties 36 units in 4 hours

⇒ Efficiency of R = 36 ÷ 4 = 9 units/hr

⇒ Net combined rate of P, Q and R = 7 + 5 − 9 = 3 units/hr

⇒ Time taken to fill the tank together = 315 ÷ 3 = 105 hours

**∴ Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in 105 hours.**

questions.question: A man walks to a viewpoint and returns to the starting point by his car maintaining constant speed and thus takes a total time of 7 hours 45 minutes. He would have gained 6 hours by driving both ways. How long would it have taken for him to walk both ways with same walking speed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total time when walking one way and returning by car = 7 hours 45 minutes = 7.75 hours

Time gained if driving both ways = 6 hours

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Time = Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Total time = Sum of individual times

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time taken if driving both ways = 7.75 − 6 = 1.75 hours

⇒ Let distance = D

⇒ Let walking speed = w

⇒ Let car speed = c

⇒ Time taken to drive both ways = 2D ÷ c

⇒ 2D ÷ c = 1.75

⇒ D ÷ c = 0.875

⇒ Time taken to walk one way = Total time − Driving time one way

⇒ D ÷ w = 7.75 − 0.875 = 6.875

⇒ Time taken to walk both ways = 2D ÷ w

⇒ Time taken to walk both ways = 2 × 6.875 = 13.75 hours

⇒ 13.75 hours = 13 hours 45 minutes

**∴ The man would have taken 13 hours 45 minutes to walk both ways.**

questions.question: The LCM of the numbers 2.8 and 0.217 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First number = 2.8

Second number = 0.217

**Formula Used:**

LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators ÷ HCF of denominators

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2.8 = 28 ÷ 10 = 14 ÷ 5

⇒ 0.217 = 217 ÷ 1000

⇒ LCM of numerators = LCM(14, 217)

⇒ 14 = 2 × 7

⇒ 217 = 7 × 31

⇒ LCM = 2 × 7 × 31 = 434

⇒ HCF of denominators = HCF(5, 1000) = 5

⇒ LCM = 434 ÷ 5

⇒ LCM = 86.8

**∴ The correct answer is 86.8.**
